messages.subject: Executive Candidate Introduction | Ireland & International Leadership Opportunities
messages.body:
Dear Lava Recruitment Team,

I am contacting you through your current official address following a failed delivery to an older route. I serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, and bring more than 12 years of experience spanning multinational mining, government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, stakeholder management, compliance and executive-level coordination.

I am open to senior opportunities in Ireland and internationally across sustainability, external affairs, government relations, strategic partnerships, corporate affairs, business development and country operations.

My executive CV is attached. I would welcome consideration for suitable current or upcoming mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
